Fire a charged arrow at the target. On hitting an enemy or wall, the arrow will fire Chaining Lightning beams at nearby enemies.
Supports Slam skills. Aftershocks caused by Supported Slam Skills always create patches of Jagged Ground.
Aftershocks caused by Supported Skills create Jagged Ground (Not supported in PoB yet)
Jagged Ground lasts 4 seconds (Not supported in PoB yet)
Supports any skill you use yourself that Hits enemies, causing it to accumulate Critical Hit chance over time, but also reduce your Critical Damage Bonus.
Supported Skills gain 40% increased Critical Hit Chance each second, up to 200%. This Critical Hit Chance is lost whenever a skill supported by Inexorable Critical Critically Hits
Supported Skills gain 10% less Critical Damage Bonus each second, up to 50%. This Critical Damage Bonus is lost whenever a skill supported by Inexorable Critical Critically Hits
Supports any skill that has a duration making that duration shorter.
Supported Skills have 30% less Skill Effect Duration
Supports Slams you use yourself, providing a powerful Ancestral Boost every few seconds.
Attacks with Supported Skill are Ancestrally Boosted, no more than once every 6 seconds
Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing them to deal more damage and trigger Nature's Exchange when consuming Freeze on enemies. Cannot support skills that Consume Freeze.
Supported Skills trigger Nature's Exchange when Consuming Freeze (Not supported in PoB yet)
Supported Skills cannot cause Freeze buildup
Supported Skills Consume Freeze on enemies to deal 50% more Damage
Grants 531 Guard (Not supported in PoB yet)
"Wild energy is as misunderstood as the Mórrigan
itself. Many revere life, yet revile death. What is dead
feeds the living. Death is but one aspect of the whole."
